vb_textbox.text: At first, I followed the advice of the previous participant, but soon realised that this could distract from the game and I could lose focus. Then I decided to look for an element that produced a higher score. However, I concluded that the game was random and that to score high and keep focus I would choose the gnome on the right hand side of the screen. To recap, you will do better if you choose the same gnome every time as you will hit the keys quicker and not run out of time.
